github.description: GitHub pull-request review through github-mcp-rw, v1.10.1 tool names. Enabled by the owner on 2026-09-02; the credential is resolved by reference in lib/mcp-invoke.js and never reaches a task. create_branch was declared for the MCP-ECOSYSTEM-2b proof only and withdrawn on 2026-09-02 (least privilege: a review skill does not create branches). Flip enabled to disable the outbound half again.

list_pull_requests.description: List pull requests for a repository (github.read).

pull_request_read.description: Read one pull request: details, diff, files, comments, reviews, status (github.read; consolidated v1.10.1 name).

pull_request_review_write.description: Create, add comments to, or submit a pull request review (github.pull_request, CONTROLLED: needs a GRANTED approval mcp:github.pull_request at invoke time).

browser.description: Governed browser through projects/mythos-browser-mcp (BrowserAdapter: Obscura CDP on 127.0.0.1:9222 PRIMARY, Playwright FALLBACK). Owner architecture 2026-09-27, superseding the V3.1 'browser NOT NEEDED' entry. Read-only page access: no clicks, no typing, no scripting, no private addresses. The Obscura token is read by the MCP server process from a 0600 env file on the browser host and never reaches a task.

navigate.description: Open a public http(s) URL; returns backend, final_url, title, load state.

extract.description: Open a public http(s) URL and return its visible text or one CSS selector's text, bounded.

screenshot.description: Open a public http(s) URL and save a viewport screenshot to the browser artifacts directory; returns path, bytes, sha256.
